method: walk-forward replay of one user's own history

split.rule: every good turn is scored against the range built from the good turns strictly before it; never itself, never a later turn

learning_phase: turns 10-29 are scored at the wide (80) range the user was actually shown

targets.50: coverage within a few points of 0.50
targets.80: coverage within a few points of 0.80

checked_by: tests/test_eval_manifest.py fails if the code's constants drift from this file
not_reproducible_from_this_repo: CLAIMS.md claim 3 (turns 1.81x longer during major incidents, 0.91x during minor ones) was measured on an earlier reference corpus that is not in this repository
